fields.name: cache_control
fields.short: Enable automatic prompt caching.

fields.name: choices
fields.short: List of completion choices

fields.name: created
fields.short: Unix timestamp of creation

fields.name: debug
fields.short: Debug options for inspecting request transformations (streaming only)

fields.name: frequency_penalty
fields.short: Frequency penalty (-2.0 to 2.0)

fields.name: id
fields.short: Unique completion identifier

fields.name: image_config
fields.short: Provider-specific image configuration options.

fields.name: logit_bias
fields.short: Token logit bias adjustments

fields.name: logprobs
fields.short: Return log probabilities

fields.name: max_completion_tokens
fields.short: Maximum tokens in completion

fields.name: max_tokens
fields.short: Maximum tokens (deprecated, use max_completion_tokens).

fields.name: messages
fields.short: List of messages for the conversation

fields.name: metadata
fields.short: Key-value pairs for additional object information (max 16 pairs, 64 char keys, 512 char values)

fields.name: min_p
fields.short: Minimum probability threshold relative to the most likely token.

fields.name: modalities
fields.short: Output modalities for the response.

fields.name: model
fields.short: Model used for completion

fields.name: models
fields.short: Models to use for completion

fields.name: parallel_tool_calls
fields.short: Whether to enable parallel function calling during tool use.

fields.name: plugins
fields.short: Plugins you want to enable for this request, including their settings.

fields.name: prediction
fields.short: Static predicted output content.

fields.name: presence_penalty
fields.short: Presence penalty (-2.0 to 2.0)

fields.name: prompt_cache_options
fields.short: Request-level prompt-cache controls.

fields.name: provider
fields.short: When multiple model providers are available, optionally indicate your routing preference.

fields.name: reasoning
fields.short: Configuration options for reasoning models

fields.name: reasoning_effort
fields.short: Shorthand for setting reasoning effort.

fields.name: repetition_penalty
fields.short: Penalizes tokens based on how much they have already appeared in the text.

fields.name: response_format
fields.short: Response format configuration

fields.name: route
fields.short: **DEPRECATED** Use providers.sort.partition instead.

fields.name: seed
fields.short: Random seed for deterministic outputs

fields.name: service_tier
fields.short: The service tier used by the upstream provider for this request

fields.name: session_id
fields.short: A unique identifier for grouping related requests (e.g., a conversation or agent workflow).

fields.name: stop
fields.short: Stop sequences (up to 4)

fields.name: stop_server_tools_when
fields.short: Stop conditions for the server-tool agent loop.

fields.name: stream
fields.short: Enable streaming response

fields.name: stream_options
fields.short: Streaming configuration options

fields.name: system_fingerprint
fields.short: System fingerprint

fields.name: temperature
fields.short: Sampling temperature (0-2)

fields.name: tool_choice
fields.short: Tool choice configuration

fields.name: tools
fields.short: Available tools for function calling

fields.name: top_a
fields.short: Consider only tokens with "sufficiently high" probabilities based on the probability of the most likely token.

fields.name: top_k
fields.short: Limits the model to choose from the top K most likely tokens at each step.

fields.name: top_logprobs
fields.short: Number of top log probabilities to return (0-20)

fields.name: top_p
fields.short: Nucleus sampling parameter (0-1)

fields.name: trace
fields.short: Metadata for observability and tracing.

fields.name: usage
fields.short: Token usage statistics

fields.name: user
fields.short: Unique user identifier

fields.name: parallel_tool_calls
fields.short: Whether to enable parallel function calling during tool use.

fields.name: plugins
fields.short: Plugins you want to enable for this request, including their settings.

fields.name: prediction
fields.short: Static predicted output content.

fields.name: presence_penalty
fields.short: Presence penalty (-2.0 to 2.0)

fields.name: previous_response_id
fields.short: Not supported.

fields.name: prompt_cache_options
fields.short: Request-level prompt-cache controls.

fields.name: provider
fields.short: When multiple model providers are available, optionally indicate your routing preference.

fields.name: reasoning
fields.short: Configuration options for reasoning models

fields.name: reasoning_effort
fields.short: Shorthand for setting reasoning effort.

fields.name: repetition_penalty
fields.short: Penalizes tokens based on how much they have already appeared in the text.

fields.name: response_format
fields.short: Response format configuration

fields.name: route
fields.short: **DEPRECATED** Use providers.sort.partition instead.

fields.name: seed
fields.short: Random seed for deterministic outputs

fields.name: service_tier
fields.short: The service tier to use for processing this request.

fields.name: session_id
fields.short: A unique identifier for grouping related requests (e.g., a conversation or agent workflow).

fields.name: stop
fields.short: Stop sequences (up to 4)

fields.name: stop_server_tools_when
fields.short: Stop conditions for the server-tool agent loop.

fields.name: stream
fields.short: Enable streaming response

fields.name: stream_options
fields.short: Streaming configuration options

fields.name: temperature
fields.short: Sampling temperature (0-2)

fields.name: text
fields.short: Text output configuration including format and verbosity

fields.name: tool_choice
fields.short: Tool choice configuration

fields.name: tools
fields.short: Available tools for function calling

fields.name: top_a
fields.short: Consider only tokens with "sufficiently high" probabilities based on the probability of the most likely token.

fields.name: top_k
fields.short: Limits the model to choose from the top K most likely tokens at each step.

fields.name: top_logprobs
fields.short: Number of top log probabilities to return (0-20)

fields.name: top_p
fields.short: Nucleus sampling parameter (0-1)

fields.name: trace
fields.short: Metadata for observability and tracing.

fields.name: user
fields.short: Unique user identifier

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.short: Normalized aspect ratio of the generated image.

fields.name: background
fields.short: Background treatment.

fields.name: created
fields.short: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the image was generated

fields.name: data
fields.short: Generated images

fields.name: input_references
fields.short: Reference images to guide image-to-image generation, as base64 data URLs or HTTP(S) URLs.

fields.name: model
fields.short: The image generation model to use

fields.name: n
fields.short: Number of images to generate (1-10).

fields.name: output_compression
fields.short: Compression level (0-100) for webp/jpeg output.

fields.name: output_format
fields.short: Encoding of the returned image bytes.

fields.name: prompt
fields.short: Text description of the desired image

fields.name: provider
fields.short: Provider routing preferences and provider-specific passthrough configuration.

fields.name: quality
fields.short: Rendering quality.

fields.name: resolution
fields.short: Normalized resolution tier of the generated image.

fields.name: seed
fields.short: If specified, the generation will sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

fields.name: size
fields.short: Optional.

fields.name: stream
fields.short: If true, partial images are streamed as SSE events as they become available.

fields.name: usage
fields.short: Token and cost usage for the image generation request, when available

fields.name: app_id
fields.short: The application ID associated with this auth code

fields.name: callback_url
fields.short: The callback URL to redirect to after authorization.

fields.name: code
fields.short: The authorization code received from the OAuth redirect

fields.name: code_challenge
fields.short: PKCE code challenge for enhanced security

fields.name: code_challenge_method

fields.name: code_verifier
fields.short: The code verifier if code_challenge was used in the authorization request

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the auth code was created

fields.name: expires_at
fields.short: Optional expiration time for the API key to be created

fields.name: id
fields.short: The authorization code ID to use in the exchange request

fields.name: key
fields.short: The API key to use for OpenRouter requests

fields.name: key_label
fields.short: Optional custom label for the API key.

fields.name: limit
fields.short: Credit limit for the API key to be created

fields.name: spawn_agent
fields.short: Agent identifier for spawn telemetry

fields.name: spawn_cloud
fields.short: Cloud identifier for spawn telemetry

fields.name: usage_limit_type
fields.short: Optional credit limit reset interval.

fields.name: user_id
fields.short: User ID associated with the API key

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.short: Optional workspace ID to associate the API key with
